title: Daily Recap — Tuesday Oct 27, 2026
html:
Links: SPY · Watchlist · Options Playbook · Fed Tracker · Federal Reserve

Bottom line

SPY rose 0.56% to $769.66, reclaiming its 50-day ($766.70) and the 38.2% retracement of the October pullback ($768.68), but closed just under the 20-day ($770.41) — the first line to clear on Fed day. Chips led for a second day, Anthropic's IPO filing lifted AI sentiment, and WTI eased to ~$100 on Iran de-escalation talks.

Earnings: BA −10.7% (737 rate-47 ramp slipped; Commercial Airplanes lost $697M); RCL +5.5% (raised outlook); HLT −2.1% despite beat (RevPAR +5.8%); KO −1.6% despite raised outlook. Fed decides Wed 2:00 pm ET; hold ~90% priced after September's hike to 3.75–4.00% (Fed Tracker).
